academy-accord-story.text: Tell this as dramatic sequential art, not an illustrated lecture card or infographic. The Academy frame creates argument, uncertainty, and changing understanding; historical reconstruction creates lived stakes. When the record is incomplete or actors disagree, preserve that disagreement instead of inventing omniscient certainty. Use current Rex Fleet production identities, faction design, corridor technology, and causal history. Treat Selene Stormwell as an evidence-first historical analyst, not a priest or keeper of sacred memory. Do not revive obsolete memorial, lantern, archive-ritual, or Memory Oath imagery. Show political ideas through concrete choices about routes, manifests, rescue priorities, command, access, and who accepts whose authority. Core, Verge, and Shard actors remain internally varied. Avoid propaganda tableaux, faction caricature, decorative treaty parchment, or symbolic empty-chair staging. Keep classroom dialogue natural and historically reconstructed dialogue specific to the immediate problem.
